selected_problem: Fresh main still used default-locale String.localeCompare in bounded repository context selection, exact-path hint ranking, extension summary ordering, and top-level summary ordering. Equivalent repository metadata therefore produced different bounded context views across host locales.
route_basis: After workspace ordering was made host-locale independent, the same reality boundary remained immediately downstream in repository-context ranking. The defect is directly reproducible and can be closed without selecting a new sampling or module-resolution architecture.
change: Replace default-locale collation in repository context tie-breakers with deterministic code-unit lexical comparison.
truth_boundary: This closes host-locale dependence in existing repository-context bounded ranking and summary views. It does not claim optimal context selection, exhaustive repository coverage, parser-grade module semantics, or locale independence in unrelated subsystems.
